 Live Last update 12:06 AM ET 2' Oct 22 12:06 AM ET 2 minutes ago 30 points lead
 Austin Reaves added two points, with Gary Payton adding two points, as well as two from Kevon Looney. Brandon Williams added two of two free throws, as well as two of two from Yaxel Lendeborg and two from Kevon Looney, making it 96 to 66 for the Lakers on the scoreboard!

 Austin Reaves added two points from two, with George Niang adding two points, with tthree from Austin Reaves, as well as two from Austin Reaves, putting the score at 92 to 61, with a 31 point lead on the scoreboard at this point in the game.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 11:57 PM ET 11 minutes ago 26 points lead
 Luka Doncic added three points, with Yaxel Lendeborg adding two points, as well as two in two from Austin Reaves, with Walker Kessler adding two points, to put the score at the moment at 85 to 59, with a big lead on the scoreboard!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 11:47 PM ET 22 minutes ago 21 points lead
 Walker Kessler added two points, plus two more in the sequence, with three points on three free throws from Curry, as well as two on two from Luka Doncic, to put the score at 78 to 57 for the Lakers over the Warriors at that moment.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 11:40 PM ET 28 minutes ago Start with points
 Austin Reaves added two points, with two more from Yaxel Lendeborg, in addition to two from Walker Kessler, followed by two from Ziaire Williams, putting the score at 72 to 54 at the start of the game where the Lakers opened up an advantage.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 11:37 PM ET 32 minutes ago THIRD QUARTER BEGINS
 The players returned to the court and the ball flew into the third quarter of the game between the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Lakers, in the NBA regular season matchup, with all the plays and excitement here on VAVEL!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 11:19 PM ET an hour ago HALFTIME
 Luka Doncic scored two points, along with one-for-two from Sandro, two from Gary Payton, and two from Luka Doncic. Walker Kessler scored two, along with two from Curry, and one from Doncic on the free throw, followed by three more, bringing the score to 66-52, taking the Lakers into halftime with a 14-point lead!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 11:11 PM ET an hour ago Seven points lead
 Quentin Grimes scored two points, followed by two from Sandro Mamukelashvili. Luka Doncic added two points from two free throws, bringing the score to 55-48 for the Lakers at the end of the second quarter!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 11:07 PM ET an hour ago One point lead
 Walker Kessler scored two points, followed by two from Jake LaRavia, plus three from Gui Santos, and two from Will Richard, bringing the score to 49-48 for the Lakers, who are winning by only one point!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 11:04 PM ET an hour ago Two points lead
 Yaxel Lendeborg scored two points, followed by Quentin Grimes with two more. Gui Santos added two points with a shot, bringing the score to 45-43 for the Lakers, who remain in the lead, but with a narrow advantage.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 10:59 PM ET an hour ago Four points lead
 Gary Payton scored two points, followed by two more, along with Quentin Grimes, in a low-scoring period, bringing the current score to 43-39 for the Lakers in this matchup, who continue to hold the lead.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 10:54 PM ET an hour ago Start with points
 Austin Reaves scored two points, with two on two free throws by Stephen Curry, while Jake LaRavia added three points. Walker Kessler also scored two points, making the score 41-35 for the Lakers in the score.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10:49 PM ET an hour ago 2nd Q Starts
 Gui Santos scored two points, along with three from Luka Doncic, two from Georges Niang, two from two free throws by Brandon Williams, and three from Jake LaRavia, to close out the first quarter and open the second with the Lakers leading 34-33!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 10:42 PM ET an hour ago One point lead
 Brandon Williams added three points, with two on two from Austin Reaves. Brandon Williams added two points, with one more on the free kick. Brandon Williams added two points, with one more from a free kick, followed by two from Sandro Mamukelashvili, putting the score at 28-27!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 10:34 PM ET 2 hours ago Lakers leading
 Stephen Curry added two points, with two points on two free throws by Austin Reaves in the sequence. Draymond Green added two, with two more from Austin Reaves and two from Stephen Curry. Lukan Doncic added two points from two, followed by three from Doncic, making the score 24-21!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 10:30 PM ET 2 hours ago Still tied
 Stephen Curry scored three points, followed by three from Luka Doncic. Stephen Curry scored two points, followed by two from Walker Kessler. The game remains close, and the score is tied once again, now at 15-15!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 10:24 PM ET 2 hours ago Tied
 Walker Kessler scored two points, with Ziaire Williams adding two more, and Stephen Curry scoring three. Curry then added two more with a layup, bringing the score to 10-10 in a game that has started very evenly!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 10:21 PM ET 2 hours ago Start with points
 Walker Kessler scored two points early on, along with two from Stephen Curry, two from Luka Doncic, Yaxel Lendeborg with three, and Walker Kessler added two more with a layup, putting the score at 6-5 for the Lakers at the start.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10:18 PM ET 2 hours ago HERE WE GO
 The players stepped onto the court and the ball flew for the Warriors vs Lakers showdown in this first quarter of the NBA regular season game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL! And, after the start, the Lakers have the first possession!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 10:06 PM ET 2 hours ago Starting five
 And here are the starting five for today's game! For the Golden State Warriors, the starting lineup is: Stephen Curry, De’Anthony Melton, Gui Santos, Yaxel Lendeborg, and Draymond Green. For the Los Angeles Lakers, the lineup is: Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Austin Reaves, and Luka Doncic.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:56 PM ET 2 hours ago Tune in here Golden State Warriors vs Los Angeles Lakers Live Score with VAVEL!
 We will soon share with you the starting lineups for the live game between the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Lakers, as well as the latest information from Crypto.com Arena. Stay tuned for live game updates and commentary from VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:51 PM ET 2 hours ago Tomorrow's games
 Tomorrow the round continues with two games: 76ers vs Cavaliers and Thunder vs Nuggets. On Friday (23) many games take place: Bucks vs Bulls, Hornets vs Hawks, Celtics vs Knicks, Pacers vs Mavericks, Wizards vs Raptors, Magic vs Timberwolves, Heat vs Pistons, Spurs vs Rockets, Jazz vs Pelicans, Lakers vs Clippers, Kings vs Trail Blazers and Warriors vs Grizzlies.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:48 PM ET 2 hours ago How to watch Golden State Warriors vs Los Angeles Lakers Live Stream and TV Online?
 If you want to watch the Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers game live on TV, your options are: ESPN, Spectrum SportsNet, and Sports Bay Area.
 If you prefer a streaming service or app, your options are: ESPN+ and FuboTV.
 If you want to watch online, VAVEL US is your best option!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:42 PM ET 2 hours ago Today's games
 We have a few games in progress right now, with the following partial results: Wizards 121-111 Bucks, Magic 114-116 Hawks, Heat 81-96 Timberwolves, Nets 74-80 Hornets, Raptors 90-56 Bulls, Pelicans 77-69 Pacers, Grizzlies 71-55 Jazz, and Rockets 63-36 Mavericks. And we will have two more games today: Trail Blazers vs Suns and Clippers vs Kings.
